entities.summary: Sayf al-Din al-Amidi or Muhammad al-Amidi was an influential Muslim jurist. Initially a Hanbalite, Al-Amidi belonged to the Shafi`i school and worked to combine kalam (theology) with existing methods of jurisprudence.
